name: YouTube Shorts — Did You Know (10 Daily)

parameters.command: =VIDEO='{{ $json.runDir }}/video.mp4'; test -s "$VIDEO" || { echo 'ERROR: video.mp4 missing'; exit 1; }; SIZE=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0:s=x "$VIDEO"); DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$VIDEO"); echo "SHORT_CHECK: ${SIZE} ${DUR}s"; test "$SIZE" = '1080x1920' || { echo "ERROR: Expected 1080x1920, got $SIZE"; exit 1; }; awk -v d="$DUR" 'BEGIN { exit !(d >= 30 && d <= 60) }' || { echo "ERROR: Duration outside 30-60 seconds: ${DUR}s"; exit 1; }; echo 'SHORT_CHECK: PASS';
